risks.title: An outside API answers slowly
risks.mitigation: Call the three outside APIs in parallel, give each a timeout of 800 ms, and keep our own work under 500 ms.

risks.title: An outside API is down
risks.mitigation: Return needs-review instead of an error, cache the last good answer, and open a circuit breaker after repeated failures.

risks.title: A retry repeats a payment or a notice
risks.mitigation: Retry only safe calls, at most 3 attempts with growing waits, and key every notice by its request number.

risks.title: A secret or bad input gets into the system
risks.mitigation: Keys come from environment variables, every endpoint validates input, and a test scans the source for key patterns.

risks.title: A crowd of organizers asks on the same day
risks.mitigation: Send the notice through the queue so the answer does not wait for e-mail, and run a load test of 20 requests a minute.

risks.title: The systems disagree about formats
risks.mitigation: One standard for the whole API: JSON, ISO 8601 dates and ISO 4217 currency codes, checked by a contract test.

assumptions: The three outside APIs stay free and keep their current format.
The three campus systems can offer a REST interface without a new product.
The team is a small student team with one semester to build.
The ratings of the options are our judgment, and every weight can be changed and scored again.
